quote: For a preorder (X, ≤) put x ∼ y iff x ≤ y and y ≤ x.

The closure profile adds `tc[r](a, b)` and `rtc[r](a, b)` — the transitive and reflexive-transitive closures of a named homogeneous binary relation — with a least-fixed-point semantics over arbitrary, possibly infinite structures.
x is a greatest element of (X, ≤) when y ≤ x for every y ∈ X.
x is minimal when no y satisfies y < x.
x is least when x < y for every y ≠ x.
`le` renders as "ranks below" but means `≤`, not `<`.
`lt` renders as "precedes" and means the strict order `<`.
